title: Isolate claim queue E2E server port
description: Claim queue E2E test used fixed port 19879, causing API timeout and port collisions. Bind test API server to port 0 and derive baseUrl from the started server handle.
acceptance: AC1: Claim queue E2E API server binds to port 0.
AC2: baseUrl uses actual bound port from server.getServer().address() after start.
AC3: No 19879 assumption remains in claim-queue.test.ts.
AC4: Target claim queue E2E passes with VITEST_INCLUDE_E2E=1.
AC7: Commit uses requested Conventional Commit subject and DCO sign-off.
AC8: Commit is pushed to origin feature/v3.36.0-EPIC-293-port-isolation.
